bullets.text: **Telco AI Growth Surge** - The telco AI market is set to explode from $2.66 billion to $50.21 billion by 2034.
**Innovative AI Startups** - Startups like **BBOX AI** and **NLPearl** are revolutionising telecom customer service with advanced AI solutions.
**Diverse 5G Strategies** - **AT&T**, **Verizon**, and **T-Mobile** are adopting distinct approaches to 5G infrastructure, impacting future performance.
**AT&T's Cloud Bet** - **AT&T** partners with **Microsoft** for a cloud-native 5G core, trading control for speed and scalability.
**Verizon's Ownership Model** - **Verizon** builds its own virtualised infrastructure, ensuring control and flexibility without relying on hyperscalers.
